rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout21 gate failure (invalid; the What-is-X questions answered with the price but also claiming no information and handing off; schedules inferred from opening hours; injury turns skipping the requested tool) and the prompt changes made in response (state what the knowledge base says and stop; opening hours do not show a session runs; call the requested tool in the same turn as injury advice); never use it to tune.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout22.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout21 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout21 (consumed 2026-11-04: invalid, tool_failed 10/15 evaluable; short correct 30% wrongly escalated; 3 fabricated).
consumed: 2026-11-04: gate invalid (tool_failed 9/15 evaluable: minor-injury turns claimed a hand-off without a tool call); multi-turn 90% (one case-pattern fault). Do not reuse.
